title: PostgreSQL fixes 52 flaws including 2004-era type confusion CVE-2026-6460
content_md:
PostgreSQL: 52 vulnerabilities fixed, including a type confusion present since 2004 (CVE-2026-6460). Releases include 18.7, 17.12 and 16.16.

via Mastodon https://www.it-connect.fr/postgresql-52-failles-cve-2026-6460-mise-a-jour/
